Bill.BriefDescription: Developing sexual harassment policies, procedures, and mandatory training for all state employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing sexual harassment policies,procedures, and mandatory training for all state employees; and addinga new section to chapter 41.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall adopt rules, under RCW 41.06.400(2)(b),developing policies, procedures, and mandatory training programs onsexual harassment for all state employees. The cost of the trainingprograms shall be borne by state agencies within existing resources.
